title: Solar Fleet Ownership Changes: Align Salesforce Asset Owners With NetSuite Billing Customers
summary: Handle solar asset ownership changes without moving historical service obligations or invoices to the wrong customer.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Solar service organizations should model asset ownership, site contacts, service agreements and billing customers as separate effective-dated relationships. Salesforce–NetSuite two-way sync can distribute approved updates, but a change in the current asset owner must not rewrite historical invoices or automatically transfer an agreement. Finance and contract administration should review the commercial transition, while asset administration preserves the equipment and service history at the site.


Explore the complete[solar installation and o&m services integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/solar-installation-service) for the systems and processes around this guide.
